response.overview: The footage captures G.I.S.M.’s guest appearance at the "Final Wars" concert—headlined by Psychic TV—on Jan. 16, 1986. During the set, G.I.S.M. frontman Sakevi Yokoyama ignited a gas burner and stormed into the audience. The organizers, deeming this a dangerous act, cut the sound; the band responded with fierce protest. The entire sequence of events—including a subsequent confrontation with a reporter from a weekly magazine who was filming the incident—is included here, completely uncut.  The performance and the surrounding events were captured in their entirety using a single Sony Betamovie camera. At the time, per Sakevi Yokoyama’s wishes, the footage was released as an unedited, uncut work.  Additionally, the package includes a bonus disc featuring a live DVD of the "Apocalypse 666" show, held at Shinjuku Antiknock in 1992.
response.title: G.I.S.M. 「GASBURNER PANIC」
